name: NF-A4x10 FLX
description: The Noctua NF-A4x10 FLX is a premium 40×10mm axial fan widely used as a hotend or electronics cooling fan in 3D printers. It features Noctua's SSO2 (Self-Stabilising Oil-pressure Bearing 2) for exceptional longevity and low noise. The FLX variant ships with a Low-Noise Adapter and a 3-pin to 2-pin connector, making it compatible with most 3D printer boards at 12V.
